items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: He's the guy that was Irving Mills

ctx.x: The Chief and it'll tell you all about a job. Because he had a job, you know.

So in the meantime, I had this paper and looking at it, and so, fooling around down Broadway, you know, as usual, walking around seeing the different guys, you know, making a little record here and there. I forget the guy we made the records with. We were making a lot of stuff with Coleman Hawkins and Foots Thomas, who used to be with Cab, and Barefield, and all those. Joe something was his name. Put out a whole series of eight tracks there for awhile. I mean 78s. And I'm looking for something, looking around,…
